title: Amp Up
lines: Amp up your strikes with the new Hammer Amp Up!
Energize your game! The Amp Up features our PowerShot asymmetric core, first used in the Amp, and designed to provide ultra-high mid-lane revolutions with a very defined breakpoint.
Energize your pin action today and throw more strikes with the new Hammer Amp Up!
FACTORY FINISH 500-500-500 Abralon®, 1500 Abranet™, Powerhouse™ Factory Finish
